title: The Estrella Adobe Church
text: The Estrella Adobe Church, on Airport Road north of Highway 46, was the first Protestant church built in northern San Luis Obispo County. Settlers on the Estrella Plains built it in 1879, making the adobe bricks on the site and hauling lumber over the mountains. As the congregations moved on to churches of their own, it fell out of use and crumbled into ruins. Young men from a boys' school made thousands of new adobe bricks to rebuild it, and it was rededicated in 1952.
